contracts.description: Gateshead Council require suitably qualified and experience insurance companies (NOT BROKERS) to provide suitable Material Damage and Associated Terrorism Cover (Perils covered - all risks of physical loss or damage including full theft, glass breakage and subsidence) for The sage Gateshead.   Gateshead Council will follow the Competitive Procedure with Negotiation for this procurement process.
